title.zh: v2.2.0 手机端默认进入新外壳：首页 / 即兴 / 挑战 / 探索 / 更多
title.en: v2.2.0 The Phone Lands in the New Shell by Default: Home, Jam, Challenge, Explore, More

highlights.zh: **手机打开应用就进新界面。** 裸访问「/」在手机上现在直接落在新外壳的**首页**；带明确目的地的链接（`?tab=` / `?genre=` / `?groove=` / `?m=`）仍按它写的渲染——这是**分阶段的切换**：新外壳成为手机的默认入口，同时旧路由保持可达，所以老书签不会在被重写的情况下悄悄换页。判断规则 `shouldEnterPhoneShell` 是纯函数并有单测（手机裸访问进外壳；带任何目的地都不动；桌面永不重定向；已在新路由不重复进入）。
highlights.en: **Opening the app on a phone now lands in the new interface.** A bare `/` goes straight to the shell's **首页**; a URL that names a destination (`?tab=` / `?genre=` / `?groove=` / `?m=`) still renders what it names. That is the **staged cutover**: the shell becomes the phone's default entry while the old routes stay reachable, so an existing bookmark is never silently rewritten. highlights.zh: **顺带把手机触控目标提到标准之上**：切过来之后，矩阵里那条「手机面上不允许有低于 44 px 的控件」的检查立刻量出了新外壳自己的问题——分类胶囊 36 px、曲风行 42 px、色块试听键正好 44 px（分数布局下量到 43.99 就被判不合格）。全部提到 **44–48 px**，胶囊同时加 `min-w`（「全部」只有 44 px 宽也算了）。**这条检查是旧手机 IA 的，但它对新界面一样有效**，所以没有放宽门禁，而是把新界面改到合规。
highlights.en: **The phone's touch targets were raised while cutting over**: the matrix's rule that no phone surface may have a control under 44 px immediately measured the new shell's own offenders — 36 px category chips, 42 px genre rows, and the 44 px swatch button (fractional layout measures it as 43.99, which fails). All are now **44-48 px**, and the chips also got a `min-w` (the "All" chip was only 44 px wide). That check belongs to the old phone IA, but it is just as true of the new…

highlights.zh: **测试**：切换规则 3 条单测（分阶段切换的三种情形）；E2E 新增一条**只在手机/平板 target 上跑**的检查：裸访问 `/` 必须落在外壳且五格齐全。加上既有的 `/m/<module>` 可达性、曲风详情往返、播放器、即兴、挑战、探索、更多等检查，新界面现在有 8 段端到端断言在四个手机/平板 target 上运行。
highlights.en: **Tests**: 3 unit cases for the cutover rule (the three shapes of the staged switch), plus a new E2E leg that runs **only on the phone/tablet targets**: a bare `/` must land in the shell with all five modules present. Together with the existing `/m/<module>` reachability, genre-detail round trip, player, jam, challenge, explore and more legs, the new interface now has eight end-to-end assertions running on all four phone/tablet targets.
